hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB only for main quantitative comparisons
baseline: Target-version representations; independent native raw endpoint where available. Historical shared-prefix references must be explicitly distinguished.
primary_transition: vidore/colqwen2-v0.1 -> vidore/colqwen2-v1.0 (602112 pixels, original shipped common contract)

groups.ranking: 3420-page shared gallery, 1033 queries grouped by five public datasets; A100, BF16, page batch 1; target suffix reference shares prefix. No independent encoding claim.
groups.endpoint: 200 distinct pages from six public datasets; 1033 query texts ranked on ONLY those 200 pages; native raw vs persisted-state replay; A100, BF16, page batch 1.
groups.mechanism: First eight frozen pages, five controlled cases; same target native baseline; no population estimate.
groups.processor: 200 frozen pages, CPU input equality; 16 stratified GPU checks. Reuse fraction is not time saving.

main_routes: stale source representations scored by target queries

excluded_from_main_comparison.4090: Different hardware and approximate protocols; no conversion to A100-equivalent time.
excluded_from_main_comparison.mmdocir_73_percent: Approximate route with previous-run raw reference, not a same-run exact baseline.
excluded_from_main_comparison.energy_batch4_time: Different pages and batching; independent equality may be listed separately, not pooled into batch1 time.
excluded_from_main_comparison.historical_stage_time: No IO and not a native paired raw endpoint; retained only as contextual prior evidence, not combined with endpoint seconds.
excluded_from_main_comparison.bridges_hot_refresh: Not needed to establish current mechanism; heterogeneous fitting/budget caveats excluded from the main package.

statistics: Descriptive results for fixed observed sets. No p-values or population confidence intervals; page latency SD is page heterogeneity, not uncertainty of repeated runs. Micro query mean and equal-dataset macro mean are explicitly distinct.
new_gpu_runs: None: existing paired endpoints and controlled interventions cover the chosen questions.
